dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and consistent geometric narrowing from the mid-thoracic region towards a sharp posterior point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical protrusion visible on the right lateral margin at the mid-body point; the left margin exhibits a minor indentation followed by a subtle bulge at the pectoral insertion.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire dorsal plane with minimal low-frequency shadow casting.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark circular aperture located on the anterior dorsal midline; multiple faint, parallel linear marks (low-contrast) on the left lateral-dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle transverse geometric depression visible across the dorsal axis immediately posterior to the head/neck region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine-scale linear raking or superficial scratches are visible on the left side of the mid-dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: The centrally located dark circular feature on the anterior dorsal surface provides a unique high-contrast focal point against the white baseline.
